title: 2025年6月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions. But most of us have conflicting feelings about dressing up and feel guilty about taking the time to focus on clothes. Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.

P2 We hear sayings like "dress for the job you want; not the job you have". Most people don't really believe in them, but research into the impact of clothes on behavior now suggests that there may actually be a grain of truth in these sayings. Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing.

P3 We consider some clothes to be powerful, some to be fun, and so on. We even evaluate people whom we have just met based on their clothes. We also evaluate ourselves based on what we are wearing because of the way they make us feel. This means that the experience of wearing something affects our attitudes and our choice of behavior.

P4 There's a reason tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'. It seems that wearing formal office wear puts us in the right frame of mind to conduct business. Wearing power clothing makes us feel more confident and even increases hormones needed for displaying dominance. This in turn helps us become better negotiators and abstract thinkers.

P5 While a good suit works wonders for our performance in the boardroom, wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize. Studies have found that people tend to be less open and less able to relax when they wear formal clothes.

P6 On the other hand, a casual dress helps us become more friendly and creative. These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week. I mean, who wants to hang out with people in their suits?

questions.q: What does science suggest the right dress may do?
options: Add to our advantage in work and life.
Enable us to look a lot more attractive.
Help us to enjoy a fuller personal life.
Provide extra energy for what we do.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does science suggest the right dress may do? 直接问 science 提出 dress 会 做什么，属于针对原文某句客观事实的复述。 46. What does science suggest the right dress may do? A) Add to our advantage in work and life. B) Enable us to look a lot more attractive. C) Help us to enjoy a fuller personal life. D) Provide extra energy for what we do.

【拆句】主干 What does science suggest the right dress may do? 是宾语从句嵌套：science 后 跟省略 that 的宾语从句 the right dress may do What；理解上把 What 还原到从句末 尾，即可看清问的是 dress 的功能/作用。

【定位】Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives. 科学现在表明，穿对衣服可以在我们的职业与生活中给予我们额外的优势。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 the extra edge ↔Add to our advantage in our professional and personal lives ↔in work and life 选项 Add to our advantage in work and life. 恰好覆盖「在职业与生活中增加优 势」，与预判完全吻合。 B) 偷换概念 原文谈的是 the extra edge（优势），选项 Enable us to look a lot more attractive. 把它换成了外貌吸引力，方向不同。 C) 以偏概全 原文同时强调 professional and personal lives 两方面，选项 Help us to enjoy a fuller personal life. 只保留 personal life，丢掉了职业一面。 D) 偷换概念 原文是 the extra edge（优势），选项 Provide extra energy for what we do. 把 edge 换成 energy（精力），属于熟词僻义误读。 科学研究为何认为一个人所穿的衣服可能会影响他们与他人的互动? A) 衣服通常代表一个人的社会和经济地位。 B) 衣服在很大程度上决定一个人是否受到周围人的喜爱。 C) 不同类型的服装明显反映出不同的个性。 D) 不同类型的服装象征性地传达不同的信息。

questions.q: Why does science say the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others?
options: Clothes usually represent one's social and economic status.
Clothes largely determine one's likability by people around.
Different types of clothing markedly reflect different personalities.
Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 Why does science say the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others? 问的是原因，原文应有 because/due to 等显式因果标志。

【拆句】主干为 Why does science say … ；say 后是省略 that 的宾语从句 the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others，其中 one wears 是修饰 clothes 的省略关系代 词的定语从句，理解为「人们穿的衣服」。 47. Why does science say the clothes one wears may affect their interaction with others? A) Clothes usually represent one's social and economic status. B) Clothes largely determine one's likability by people around. C) Different types of clothing markedly reflect different personalities. D) Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically.

【定位】Science says that the clothes we wear affect our behavior, our mood and even the way we interact with others because of the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing. 科学表明，我们所穿的衣服会影响我们的行为、情绪甚至我们与他人互动的方式，这是因为 我们赋予不同类型衣物的象征意义。

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文从未提及 social and economic status，Clothes usually represent one's social and economic status. 是凭印象添加。 B) 偷换概念 原文谈的是衣服带来的象征意义影响互动，选项 Clothes largely determine one's likability by people around. 把它替换为「决定一个人受不受人喜欢」，并加重为 largely determine。 C) 偷换概念 原文说衣服传递象征意义，选项 Different types of clothing markedly reflect different personalities. 把它换成「反映性格」，personalities 是原文没有的概念。 D) ✓ 正确 the symbolic meaning that we assign to different types of clothing ↔ Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically. assign ↔convey 选项 Different types of clothing convey different messages symbolically. 把原文因 果端逐一对应，是同义复述。 我们所穿的衣服如何影响我们对自己的评价? A) 通过对我们的判断力产生影响。 B) 通过影响我们对自己的感受。 C) 通过影响我们作为评估依据的内容。 D) 通过影响我们对象征性信息的解读。

questions.q: How do the clothes we wear sway our evaluation of ourselves?
options: By exerting an effect on our power of judgment.
By impacting how we feel about ourselves.
By affecting what we take as the basis for assessment.
By influencing our interpretation of symbolic messages.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 How do the clothes we wear sway our evaluation of ourselves? 问的是「通过什 么方式」，答案对应原文一句解释机制的话。

【拆句】题干主干 the clothes … sway our evaluation of ourselves；the clothes 后省略了 that， 跟着定语从句 we wear，整体读作「我们所穿的衣服如何影响我们对自己的评价」。 48. How do the clothes we wear sway our evaluation of ourselves? A) By exerting an effect on our power of judgment. B) By impacting how we feel about ourselves. C) By affecting what we take as the basis for assessment. D) By influencing our interpretation of symbolic messages.

【定位】We also evaluate ourselves based on what we are wearing because of the way they make us feel. 我们也会基于所穿衣服来评价自己，因为衣服会影响我们的感受。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文 the way they make us feel 谈的是 feel（感受），选项 By exerting an effect on our power of judgment. 换成了 power of judgment（判断力），概念发生偏移。 B) ✓ 正确 the way they make us feel ↔how we feel about ourselves because of ↔By impacting 选项 By impacting how we feel about ourselves. 把原文 the way they make us feel 用 how we feel about ourselves 改写，完全贴合预判。 C) 答非所问 选项 By affecting what we take as the basis for assessment. 描述的是「影响我们用 什么作为评判依据」，等于反过来在说「clothes 改变了我们的评判标准」，可原文只说 clothes 让我们对自己有感受，再据此评价自己，并未谈「评判标准本身」。 D) 张冠李戴 symbolic messages 是第 2 段谈衣服影响互动的原因，选项 By influencing our interpretation of symbolic messages. 把它挪到了第 3 段评价自我的机制上，张冠 李戴。 作者为何说合身的西装外套与"为成功而着装"相关联? A) 它们是正式商务往来所必需的。 B) 它们可能帮助人们专注于自己的业务。 C) 它们对于在商务交易中保持主导地位至关重要。 D) 它们可能使人们拥有正确的经商心态。

questions.q: Why does the author say tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'?
options: They are necessary for formal business dealings.
They may help people concentrate on their business.
They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions.
They may enable people to have the right mentality for doing business.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why does the author say tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'? 问作者为何这么说，正是细节原因题的典型表述。

【拆句】主干 Why does the author say + 宾语从句 tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'；be associated with 是固定搭配「与……相关」，being 引导的动 名词短语作介词宾语，整体读作「为什么作者说西装外套与『为成功而着装』相关」。

【定位】There's a reason tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'. It seems that wearing formal office wear puts us in the right frame of mind to conduct business. 西装外套之所以被认为与「为成功而着装」相关，是有原因的。看起来，穿正式办公着装会 让我们进入做生意的正确心理状态。 49. Why does the author say tailored jackets are associated with being 'dressed for success'? A) They are necessary for formal business dealings. B) They may help people concentrate on their business. C) They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions. D) They may enable people to have the right mentality for doing business.

【选项】A) 过度推断 原文只说西装让人进入做生意心态，并未声称它是 necessary（必要条件），They are necessary for formal business dealings. 把「有帮助」拔高为「必备」。 B) 偷换概念 原文是 the right frame of mind（正确的心理状态），选项 They may help people concentrate on their business. 把它换成 concentrate（集中注意力），属于偷换。 C) 过度推断 原文 Wearing power clothing makes us feel more confident and even increases hormones needed for displaying dominance. 是讲附加效果，选项 They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions. 把它拔高为「对保持优势地 位至关重要」，既偏离了 Q49 问的「为何被称为 dressed for success」，又把程度上 拉到 vital。 D) ✓ 正确 puts us in the right frame of mind ↔enable people to have the right mentality to conduct business ↔for doing business 选项 They may enable people to have the right mentality for doing business. 把原 文「让我们处于做生意的正确心态」逐一对应，是同义复述。 当人们想要进行社交时,建议他们做什么? A) 注重服装。 B) 穿一套好西装。 C) 穿着随意。 D) 看起来与众不同。

questions.q: What are people advised to do when they want to socialize?
options: Focus on clothing.
Wear a good suit.
Dress casually.
Look unusual.
questions.explain:
【判型】What are people advised to do when they want to socialize? 询问具体建议行为，是典 型的细节复述。

【拆句】主干 What are people advised to do；when 引导时间状语从句 they want to socialize，整体读作「当人们想社交时，建议穿什么」。被动语态 are advised 隐含「文章 作者建议」。

【定位】On the other hand, a casual dress helps us become more friendly and creative. These findings support the idea of wearing business casuals on a Friday; since colleagues are most likely to take out time to socialize on the last work day of the week. 另一方面，休闲着装能让我们变得更友好、更有创造力。这些发现支持周五穿商务休闲装的 做法，因为同事们最有可能在一周的最后一个工作日抽时间社交。 50. What are people advised to do when they want to socialize? A) Focus on clothing. B) Wear a good suit. C) Dress casually. D) Look unusual.

【选项】A) 答非所问 原文从未建议把注意力集中在「衣服」本身，Focus on clothing. 与「社交场合该穿什 么」毫无对应。 B) 与原文相反 原文明说 wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize，选项 Wear a good suit. 恰好建议穿西装，与原文方向相反。 C) ✓ 正确 a casual dress ↔Dress casually wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize ↔Dress casually 选项 Dress casually. 把 a casual dress 的建议浓缩为祈使句，完整对应原文。 D) 无中生有 原文从未提到「穿得与众不同」，Look unusual. 是凭空生造的建议。
